description.narrative: The development objective of the Eastern Africa Regional Statistics Program-for-Results (PforR) Project for Kenya, Rwanda, Tanzania, East African Community (EAC), and Africa Union is to strengthen the regional harmonization, dissemination and use of core economic and social statistics for Kenya, Rwanda, and Tanzania. The program reflects priorities emphasized in the World Bank's World Development Report on Data for better lives as well as respective World Bank strategies. The operation comprises a Program using the PforR financing instrument and a Project using the investment project financing (IPF) instrument. The Operation will therefore combine the benefits of the PforR instrument of effective delivery through Government systems with two more closely monitored IPF components for African Union Institute of Statistics (STATAFRIC) and the EAC Secretariat's Statistics Department to build technical assistance for the implementation of the PforR Program. The PforR instrument has distinct advantages for effective and sustainable implementation of nationalprograms, which are essential to reach the regional objective.
To strengthen the regional harmonization, dissemination and use of core economic and social statistics for Kenya, Rwanda and Tanzania.

condition.narrative: AU: Schedule 2, Section I. B.1 (b) The Recipient shall recruit or assign, as appropriate and agreed upon with the Association, forPart 2(a) of the Project: (i) a safeguards expert to be based at the PIU within STATAFRIC; (ii) a monitoring and evaluation expertto be based at the PIU within STATAFRIC; (iii) a finance assistant to be based at the PIU within STATAFRIC; (iv) an internalauditor to be based at AU headquarters; and (v) a finance officer to be based at AU headquarters with terms of reference,experience and qualifications satisfactory to the Association, not later than six (6) months from the Effective Date or at a laterdate agreed upon in writing with the Association.

EAC: Schedule 2, Section I. B.2 (b) The recipient shall recruit an additional procurement consultant for the Project ImplementationUnit within the EAC Secretariat, with qualifications and experience and under terms of reference satisfactory to the Association,within six (6) months from the Effective Date.

KEN: Schedule 2, Section I, B.3 (a) The recipient shall establish, by no later than three months after the effectiveness date, andmaintain thereafter, a Program Steering Committee (PSC) to be chaired by the Principal Secretary of the Recipient's Statedepartmentresponsible for Planning, and comprising of the Principal Secretary of the National Treasury, the Director General of theKNBS, and any other members who may be co-opted by the PSC.
